description: SINOE ® - Annuaire 2016 des unités d'incinération des ordures ménagères (UIOM) is published by ADEME. The SINOE directory lists municipal-waste incineration facilities with identifiers and operating characteristics. Its stated coverage is France; national 2016 facility directory. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. The reference year is historical and does not establish present operational status. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
